High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned APP for the State and learned counsel for the victim.
2. This is a successive bail application of the applicant in Crime No.42 of 2023 registered with Manwat Police Station, District Parbhani for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376 (2) (j)
(i) of the Indian Penal Code.
3. After hearing the learned counsel for the applicant the Court was not satisfied that there were change in circumstances.
The Courts have flooded with the matters and cases against the women.
There appears no deliberate delay in opening the case.
So far as keeping the matters pending for muddemal property, this Court has already issued the directions to all the concern to examine the witnesses not concerned with muddemal.
